votes.motion: Approve the Special Permit for 1 Main Street with condition that construction be completed within 30 days of commencement
votes.quote: m. jeffreys, motion amended, that from the time construction begins to construction completion, a period of no more than 30 days elapse, second amended, d. prokowiew, all aye.

votes.motion: Approve the 5 & 9 Electric Avenue Asian Imperial plan and supersede the 2011 Decision, removing Conditions #1–12, retaining #13–15, and adding new conditions for site striping, handicap accommodations, fire lanes, lighting, and construction hours
votes.quote: k. chenis, motion to approve the 5 & 9 electric avenue asian imperial plan and supersede the 2011 decision with the following, remove conditions #1 through #12; leave conditions #13 through #15, and add the following conditions: abide by approvals of all other town boards and commissions, striping of all lots, including handicapped spots, add handicap signage to existing lot, fire lanes to be installed and striped as required by the fire chief, the spotlight at the south side of the building will be removed no later than the completion of phase 2, all new lighting will be dark sky compliant, construction hours will be between 7 and 4, monday through friday, and after january 1st they will include 8 to 12 on saturdays, no construction on sundays and holidays, second, d. prokowiew, all aye.

votes.motion: Grant all requested waivers for the 1 Main Street Special Permit application
votes.quote: m. jeffreys, motion, to grant all requested waivers, second, d. prokowiew, all aye.

votes.motion: Close the Public Hearing for 1 Main Street
votes.quote: d. prokowiew, motion to close public hearing, second, k. chenis, all aye.
